coder_notes: Paediatric DIPG/DMG trial (ages 12 months to 18 years in inclusion); glioblastoma not named anywhere, so not_glioblastoma. Balstilimab is the only investigational drug in Part A (experimental_monotherapy there) but combined with zalifrelimab in Parts B and C; coded experimental_combination. Histone (H3K27M) mutation required for entry (with radiographically typical DIPG exempt from biopsy); not candidate-matched. Immune-response correlates (neo-antigen T cell responses) relate mainly to the vaccine, so target engagement for the candidates coded unclear. Arm labels copied up to the colon of each registered arm.
